title: cdt-prediction-bench: reproducibility bundle for "Online Routing for Next-Action Prediction"

creators.name: Langiu, Alessio
creators.affiliation: CNR-ISMAR, Institute of Marine Sciences, National Research Council of Italy

creators.name: Pilato, Giovanni
creators.affiliation: CNR-ICAR, Institute for High-Performance Computing and Networking, National Research Council of Italy

description:
Reproducibility bundle (artefact C4) for the paper Online Routing for Next-Action Prediction (Langiu & Pilato). It contains the full benchmark used in the paper: the three corpus builders (D1 UCI Unix shell, D3 Eclipse UDC, D4 WebLINX), the seven classical pool predictors (PST, PPM, CTW leaf-KT, Lempel-Ziv, Markov-1/2/3), the three static CTW variants including the faithful binary and faithful M-ary mixtures (the confirmatory baseline), the regret-bounded Hedge/Fixed-Share router (soft and hard read-outs), the learned GRU expert and the router-8 driver that adds it to the pool, the three negative mechanism probes (drift-tracking, antidictionary hard-gating, zero-shot LLM hybrid) with their recorded decisions, the paired-statistics helper (bootstrap CI, Wilcoxon, Holm, TOST), and all random seeds. Leave-one-user-out protocol; results reproduce the paper's tables.

Licensing. Code, scripts and results are MIT (see LICENSE). The derived D4 (WebLINX) corpus files inherit CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 from McGill-NLP/WebLINX (Lù et al. 2024); see data/D4-weblinx/LICENSE. Raw source datasets are not redistributed and are refetchable from their public sources per the SOURCE.md files.
notes: Companion artefact to the manuscript under submission to Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (DMKD). Code MIT; D4 derived data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
